lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice explaining a preference with a short reason chain using eftersom and därför.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing between everyday habits, services, or travel options and giving a reason.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining why one option is preferred.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss two everyday options and explain the reason one fits better.

main_focus.name: reason and result with eftersom and därför
main_focus.description: Use eftersom to give a reason and därför to show a result, while keeping Swedish word order clear.
model_examples: Jag väljer bussen eftersom den är billigare.
Den tar längre tid, därför behöver vi åka tidigare.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use eftersom or därför naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic opinion phrases: jag tycker att
avoid_grammar: concession connectors such as trots att as the main focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use reason and result chunks that support short spoken explanations.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person states a preference between two options.
dialogue_shape.middle: They give one or two reasons and connect those reasons to practical consequences.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on the option or decide what information would change the decision.

target_complexity.repetition: include both reason and result patterns with clear word order

focus: the practical result of that reason

sentence_focus: one sentence with eftersom giving a reason
one sentence with därför plus V2 word order
one sentence linking a reason to a needed action
